home_lead: An open-source platform for organizing tournaments: Swiss, round robin and elimination brackets, match chat, and a REST API to automate everything around your game.
login_lead: Choose how to sign in. You can link more accounts later.
login_insecure: Not a secure method on this instance: admin pages are unavailable when you sign in with it.
dashboard_orgs_empty: You're not a member of any organization yet.
dashboard_tournaments_empty: Tournaments you join will show up here.
dashboard_untrusted: You signed in with {module}, which this instance doesn't consider secure. Sign in with a secure method to manage organizations.
profile_show_results: Show my results on my public profile
profile_show_activity: Show tournaments I'm registered for on my public profile
identities_lead: Link your accounts on other platforms. Some tournaments require them.
identities_fresh: {module} data is already up to date.
identities_session_untrusted: This method isn't secure on this instance, so admin pages are unavailable until you sign in with a secure method.
user_results_hidden: This user keeps their results private.
dashboard_orgs_untrusted: Sign in with a secure method to create organizations.
org_slug_hint: The public page will be at /o/{slug}.
org_delete_lead: This permanently deletes the organization, its tournaments and its API keys. Type {slug} to confirm.
org_delete_mismatch: Type the organization's address exactly to confirm.
members_roles_help: Owners can manage members and delete the organization. Admins can do everything else.
api_keys_lead: API keys let other applications manage this organization's tournaments through the REST API. Anyone holding a key has the same access as an admin.
api_keys_name_hint: What will use the key, e.g. "Discord bot".
api_keys_created: Copy the key for "{name}" now. You won't be able to see it again.
